top.description: Player 1 background (Marty + Doc). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A cinematic, highly detailed 1980s movie still of a single unified scene at the Twin Pines Mall parking lot at night, 1:1 square aspect ratio. On the far left, Marty McFly is standing in his iconic red puffy vest and denim jacket, holding a pink hoverboard under his arm, looking back in awe. On the far right, Doc Emmett Brown is standing with wild white hair and his white radiation suit, holding a glowing remote control with digital dials. The legendary DeLorean time machine is parked in the distant background, emitting a soft blue electrical aura. The entire middle-center area of the dark asphalt parking lot is completely clean, empty, and free of objects, with dry ice fog drifting across. Dramatic high-contrast theatrical lighting, neon blue and orange highlight reflections, film grain, photorealistic cinematic style. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

bottom.description: Player 2 background (Dystopian Biff 1985-A). Formato cuadrado 1:1, caos a los lados, centro abierto.
bottom.prompt: A cinematic, highly detailed 1980s movie still of a single unified scene representing Biff Tannen's chaotic and dystopian 1985-A alternative timeline, 1:1 square aspect ratio. On the far left, Biff Tannen as a corrupt, older billionaire in a flashy silk robe stands laughing maniacally, holding the grey sports almanac. On the far right, a chaotic street riot is occurring in a dark, burning Hill Valley, with thick black smoke, glowing orange fires, police cars with red and blue emergency flashers, and a giant neon 'Biff's Pleasure Paradise Casino' tower glowing in the background. The entire middle-center area is a clean, dark, reflective black marble penthouse floor, completely empty and free of objects. High-contrast dramatic lighting, neon red, blue, and amber reflections, chaotic movie atmosphere, film grain. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Marty y Doc jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic en el garaje. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous cinematic 1980s movie still of Marty McFly and Doc Emmett Brown sitting properly opposite each other at a wooden workbench inside Doc's messy garage laboratory, playing a match of Magic: The Gathering, vertical 9:16 portrait. Marty McFly is looking intensely focused and amazed, holding his cards which show the iconic brown Magic: The Gathering card back with the oval logo and five colored circles. Doc Brown, with wild white hair and wide, crazy eyes, is enthusiastically holding his hand of cards and pointing at a card on the table as if explaining a complex card combo. On the workbench between them, a correct Magic: The Gathering battlefield is laid out: rows of black-bordered cards, with some lands turned horizontally at 90-degrees showing they are 'tapped' (used), next to glowing electronic parts, solder wires, and tools. In the background, the silver DeLorean time machine is parked, emitting a soft neon blue glow from its rear vents. Warm ambient garage lighting, cinematic film grain, detailed faces. --ar 9:16 --no poker cards, standard playing cards, hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades, text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons
